title: Tech Note: User Definable Views Using 4D View

historical_commentary.text: 4D View itself has been discontinued, making the specific implementation obsolete, but the underlying architectural idea — a generic, user-editable "saved view" system replacing hard-coded output forms — is a genuinely durable design pattern still used today, typically realized via list box form objects with user-configurable columns or web-based grid components with saved view/filter functionality.
related_updates: 4D View has been discontinued; modern 4D list box form objects and web-based grids with user-configurable columns/filters now serve the same 'user-definable view' role
